title: 약속에 늦었을 때: 사과하고 이유 말하기
summary: A late friend apologizes and explains using -어 버리다.
setting: A café on a weekend afternoon. Minjun arrives an hour late to meet his friend Jihyeon, who has been waiting and could not reach him.

task.title: Apologize and explain
task.line: Use the words and the -어/아 버리다 pattern from the dialogue to finish each task.

words.meaning: excuse (a reason given to avoid blame)
words.exampleMeaning: I won't make excuses. It's my fault.

words.meaning: without thinking, by accident (for a moment)
words.exampleMeaning: I accidentally left my wallet in the taxi.
I fell asleep while watching a movie.

words.meaning: to go past (a stop or place)
words.example: 책을 읽다가 집 앞 정류장을 지나쳤어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I was reading and went past the stop in front of my house.
My battery died, so I couldn't check the map.
I didn't do it on purpose.

dialogue.korean: 지현 씨, 정말 미안해요. 많이 기다렸죠?
dialogue.meaning: Jihyeon, I'm really sorry. You waited a long time, didn't you?

dialogue.korean: 한 시간이나 기다렸어요. 전화도 안 받고……. 무슨 일 있었어요?
dialogue.meaning: I waited a whole hour. And you didn't answer your phone... Did something happen?

dialogue.korean: 변명 같지만 좀 들어 보세요. 지하철에서 깜빡 잠들어 버려서 내릴 역을 지나쳐 버렸어요.
dialogue.meaning: It may sound like an excuse, but please listen. I fell asleep on the subway without meaning to and went past my stop.
Then why didn't you at least contact me?

dialogue.korean: 하려고 했는데 휴대폰 배터리가 다 나가 버렸어요. 일부러 연락을 안 한 건 아니에요.
dialogue.meaning: I tried, but my phone battery died completely. I didn't skip contacting you on purpose.

dialogue.korean: 걱정하게 해서 정말 미안해요. 다음부터는 조심할게요.
dialogue.meaning: I'm really sorry I made you worry. I'll be more careful from now on.

exercises: Fill in the blank with the past form of -어/아 버리다 (자다): 아침에 알람을 못 듣고 늦잠을 ____.
Choose 일부러 or 깜빡 for each blank: ① 친구 생일을 ____ 잊어버렸어요. ② 그 사람이 ____ 제 발을 밟은 건 아니에요.
You were talking on the phone and missed your bus stop. Explain this in Korean with 지나치다 and -어/아 버리다: 통화하다가 ____.
Answer in Korean. Use 잠들다 with -어/아 버리다 to give your reason: 친구: 어젯밤에 왜 문자 답장을 안 했어요?
answers: 통화하다가 내릴 정류장을 지나쳐 버렸어요. (Also correct: 통화하다가 정류장을 지나쳐 버렸어요.)
일찍 잠들어 버려서 문자를 못 봤어요. (Also correct: 일찍 잠들어 버렸어요. / 피곤해서 잠들어 버렸어요.)
